core_obligations: Derive the functorial direct sum decomposition p^{-1}p_*A = A \oplus I(A) of (2) from the functorial maps A \to p^{-1}p_*A \to A whose composition is id_A, taking I(A) to be the kernel of the adjunction map p^{-1}p_*A \to A (proof lines 7253-7258).
Establish left exactness of p_* : Ab \to Ab(C) via the lemma on exactness of the pushforward-pullback pair of this chapter (proof lines 7258-7259).
Establish that p_* transforms surjections into surjections via the cited Sites lemma, and conclude that p_* is exact, proving (1) (proof lines 7260-7262).
proof_roadmap: Use the adjunction unit and counit from Sites to split off I(A) as the kernel of the counit.
Prove left exactness of p_* from the pushforward-pullback exactness lemma of this chapter.
Add preservation of surjections from the Sites skyscraper-exactness lemma and conclude.
difficulty_reason: The proof does two things: (2) constructs the functorial direct sum decomposition from the adjunction between p^{-1} and p_* recorded in Sites, taking I(A) to be the kernel of the counit p^{-1}p_*A \to A; (1) assembles exactness of p_* from left exactness (proved earlier in this chapter via the exactness of the pushforward-pullback pair) and preservation of surjections (a Sites lemma). The splitting-with-kernel construction and the two-fact assembly of exactness are the substance; each ingredient is spelled out in the proof lines.
